findings.description: The rewrapped Added bullet leaves one line of about 130 columns: "included), `review_depth`, `review_areas` and `permission_denials`. `tokens` is labelled as the orchestrator's own turns, which it always was." The rest of the file wraps near 100 columns. The deleted `schema_version is now 3.` clause forced a reflow that was not done. Rewrapping after "`permission_denials`." restores the width.

"With the fields under Added, the metrics `schema_version` goes from 1 to 3" is loose. It points at the Added bullet listing `model_usage`, `review_depth`, `review_areas` and `permission_denials`, and that bullet no longer mentions `schema_version`. The reader can still infer the link, so it misleads no one. Naming the fields in this bullet would be more self-contained. Optional.

permission_denials.input: cd /home/runner/work/agentspine/agentspine; git log --oneline -S'SCHEMA_VERSION = ' -- src/review/metrics.script.ts; git log --oneline | grep -i 'cut 0.1.3\|0\.1\.3'; sed -n 130,136p CHANGELOG.md; sed
